scope: BF16 peer-table Dispatch final Xe writers only. Offline source analysis; no implementation/device/ABI-progress qualification.

layout.formula: final_row(e,source,token,slot)=sum totals of earlier local experts + sum count(e,s) for s<source + source-local expert ordinal(token,slot). Ordinal is stable token/slot prefix, including duplicate occurrences. Xe is expert-major, then original-source-major, then token/slot. Each(e,source) has a contiguous possibly-empty segment; it is not globally source-major.
layout.qualification: Logical final rows are contiguous segments; actual transport order/owner/QP is not contiguous row order. Original source differs from final network sender for relayed rows.

writer_paths.name: self primary
writer_paths.mapping: Scan original source route indices over tokens*topk partition. Nonnegative encoded destination only: rank=encoded/address_stride must equal self; final row=encoded%address_stride, source token=route_index/topk. Negative secondary/complement routes do not enter this primary writer.
writer_paths.role: LocalFirst(world)..31; world8=>7..31, otherworld=>24..31. worker=logicalrole-LocalFirst; DispatchSplitRange partitions original flattened routes.
writer_paths.retire: CopyDeepepRows tiles full row bytes through twoUB buffers; MTE3_MTE2 protects stage reuse, MTE2_MTE3 orders loads before stores, both MTE3_MTE2 final waits drain stores. DDR barrier then perwriter done generation. localworker0 waits all local done and publishes self primary-ready. That is all self primary writes, not complete local expert expansion.

writer_paths.name: direct/primary same-server FM
writer_paths.mapping: Notify plan rows pair(inputtoken, bases[expert]+expertordinal), selected primary flags&2, excluding self. Directory phase begin/count owns pair range. WQE dst=live PeerHiddenAddress + pair.finalrow*row_bytes; src=input + pair.token*row_bytes.
writer_paths.role: source logicalrole0..6 maps destination local lane=(sourceRank%8+role+1)%lanes. Same privateFM QP0 is used in primary then secondaryforward order.
writer_paths.retire: Metadata NativeLoad, MTE2_V thenSIMT WQE build, V_MTE3 thenPublishFmPreparedRows orders descriptor publication/doorbell, not payload completion. Nonempty relay primary range publishes primary-ready unsignaledSO on same orderedQP. Final FinishFmRows SO+udma_qp_quiet covers primary and relays, then lane2 terminal publish. Direct-only primary rows need no early source-ready; terminal remains required.

writer_paths.name: cross-server Clos primary (gateway Xe row)
writer_paths.mapping: Same Notify pair(inputtoken,finalrow) but grouped by destination/relay-direct phase/QP. Whole-peer ordinal selects 3:1 QP0/QP1 including explicit tail rule. WQE dst=published gateway Xe base + finalrow*row_bytes; source=inputtoken. Gateway primary row is itself one expert occurrence and may be read again to expand other expert occurrences.
writer_paths.role: logical8..15 QP0 owner=role-8; logical16..23 QP1 owner=role-16; peer_order Peer selects gateway local lane=owner with destination server traversal.
writer_paths.retire: WQE cacheNativeLoad/SIMT build+event order then bounded packet/doorbell; not remote payload completion. PhaseSO CQ snapshots are published to helper7; helper checks bothQP snapshots before source-ready fanout/ACK, with MTE3_S/DDR or SIMT fence publication. FinishClosSplit waits finalCQ+helperACK and quiet, then publishes done lane0/1. No perrow/tileCQ exists.

writer_paths.name: gateway local expansion (received source or own source)
writer_paths.mapping: forward_list[source,record,6] col2=primaryrow, col3=finaltargetrank or-1 for direct, col4=finaltargetrow. Select col3==self, producing(primaryrow,finalrow). Read Xe[primaryrow], write Xe[finalrow]; same payload copied unchangedBF16. Record is skipped/parked only if selected rows exist and original-source primary-ready absent.
writer_paths.role: LocalFirst..31; SplitLocalForwardRange partitions each original source rawrecord range with CSR-offset rotation, then filters selftarget. Owner cannot be inferred from finalrow//128.
writer_paths.retire: SIMT decode/vector mask+GatherMask+V_S gives rowpairs; CopyLocalForwardRecords batches<=4, aliases repeated reads only withinbatch, MTE2_MTE3 before stores, MTE3_MTE2 pingpong. Final ForwardPeer<Local> waits bothstageevents +mte_quiet. Prefetched metadata banks Finish waitsMTE2_V thenV_S. These are local final writes; earlier source-ready only permits their input reads.

writer_paths.name: gateway remote FM final expansion to another local rank
writer_paths.mapping: Same forward cols2/3/4. Filter finaltarget peer=(gatewayRank%8+logicalrole+1)%lanes; rowpairs(primarygatewayXeRow,finalpeerXeRow). SIMT WQE src=gatewayXe+primaryrow*rowbytes,dst=peerXe+finalrow*rowbytes. Original source may be crosshost; final network writer is the gateway, and peer terminal lane2 is indexed by that gateway sender.
writer_paths.role: gateway logical0..6 after primary work; all original source records scanned, selecting assigned destinationpeer. dedup_group_size1 disables remoteFM relay because primary already covers rankdedup.
writer_paths.retire: Only append acquired source-ready records. Carry can span128metadata tiles and original sources before32WQE flush, so a WQE batch need not align a final128row tile. V_MTE3 covers descriptor read; finalSO/quiet thenlane2 publishes remote completion. Completion of source-ready/intermediateClos is insufficient for these final writes.

metadata_for_expected_contributors: Notify source×expert count inbox and expert_totals/bases define exact(e,source)segments and expertMtile extent; full source histogram is needed, not only perexpertcount_list.

Resolved encoded destinations plus direct/primary flags identify self or original-sender primary finalrows. Notify dispatch directory and pairtable identify destination/phase/QP and exact pairinput/output rows.

forward_list[source,record,6] plus forward_counts identify primaryrow->targetrank/finalrow and originalsource; SplitLocalForwardRange gives final local writer; local-lane relation gives finalFM sender.

Current generation, descriptor epoch, logicalrole/QP-owner and packet/rowpair batch memberships can key future contributions. They are distributed metadata; there is no existing consumer-ready perexpert128row table.
tile_ready_missing: Need construct exact set of final writers intersecting [expertbase+128*m, min(expertend,base+128*(m+1))). Do not count intermediate primary arrival and its downstream expansion as two writes to the same final occurrence.

Need percontribution retired/published notification after complete rowbytes and destination visibility for each intersecting finaltile, with exact-once generation/step key. RO dataWQEs have no perrowCQE; existing queue terminal aggregates manytiles.

Cross(e,source)boundary tile can depend on several originalsources and mixed self/MTE/Clos/FM writers. QP3:1 striping and rotated rawrecord ownership can give several owners even within one source-expert segment.

Tail uses only actualrows and actualrowbytes: metadata128 andWQE32 batches are not XeM128 tile boundaries; empty expert has zero production, no consumerwait on nonexistent rows. Emptyrank still participates descriptor/control/terminal protocol.

Source primary Xe remains an input to localexpand and outgoingFM WQEs. Tile compute-read readiness is distinct from source-buffer reclaim: preserve outstandinglocalread and remoteDMAread lifetimes before reuse, plus auxiliary/kernel epoch retirement.

No current tile counter/storage/publication protocol or mixedkernel memory-acquire/reclaim proof; wholepeer flags may be retained as conservative outer completion but cannot simply be renamed tile-ready.
unknowns: Exact payload-visible semantics rely on existingSHMEM/UDMA SO/CQE/quiet contracts; this pass does not reprove device/driver memory model.
Notify andDispatch local helpers checked at currentdisk hashes; noclaim this source inventory alone binds any deployedbinary.
No new native/protocol implementation or test run; root chooses anyfuture expectedcontributor/epochprotocol.
